caption:
The AI built a reusable form field. On a page with one field it's perfect. Add a second one and tapping the Phone label puts the cursor in Email.

Look at the card. Every Field renders id="field". An id must be unique in the page. When two elements share one, htmlFor connects the label to the first element with that id. Both labels point at the Email input, and a screen reader finds no label for Phone.

useId gives each Field its own id, and the id matches between server and client rendering.

No id at all also works: put the input inside the label.

Source: react.dev, useId; MDN, The Label element.
